summary_rationale: KORU (Direxion Daily MSCI South Korea Bull 3X ETF, renamed from Shares in March 2026) is a single-day, 3x leveraged derivative wrapper managed by Rafferty Asset Management, LLC. In 1H FY2026 (ended April 30, 2026), net assets peaked at $1,551.59M before moderating to $1,256.39M (July 31 NPORT-P) and $747.35M (Nov 2026), prompting expansion from four to seven Tier-1 swap dealers (BofA, Citibank, Barclays, J.P. Morgan, BNP Paribas, UBS, Nomura). Operational KPIs remain PASS_WITH_WATCH on liquidity (33.52M avg daily shares) and $1.5B fee-breakpoint discipline (waiving $2,071 in 1H FY2026; ex-interest expense ratio 0.90%). However, 2026 filings expose sharper structural frictions: Citibank doubled swap spreads to SOFR+1.70% (BNP +0.95%, UBS +0.90%) while MMF collateral yields fell to 3.52%–3.55% below 3.91% SOFR, compressing NII margin from 52.6% to 34.8%. Meanwhile, 6-month portfolio turnover jumped from 81% to 264%, April offsetting footnotes revealed $162.63M (10.48% NAV) in uncollateralized swap receivables, and Samsung+SK chaebol look-through concentration exceeds 56% (50.1% IT sector) with 1,336–1,362 KRW/USD FX sensitivity.
